detailed_description: The Ring Size Calculator helps compare ring sizes across a built-in size chart. In Convert mode, choose a US ring size button to see matching UK, EU, JP, diameter, and circumference values. In Measure mode, enter a circumference or diameter measurement in millimeters and the tool finds the nearest row from the same chart. It also displays the full conversion table and basic measurement tips for quick reference.
usage_steps: Choose Convert mode to start from a US ring size, or Measure mode to start from a millimeter measurement.
In Convert mode, click one of the US size buttons.
In Measure mode, choose circumference or diameter, then enter the measurement in millimeters.
Review the highlighted result across US, UK, EU, JP, diameter, and circumference columns, plus the full size chart.
usage_examples: Example 1: Select a US size to compare it with UK, EU, JP, diameter, and circumference values.
Example 2: Enter an inner circumference measurement in millimeters to find the nearest chart row.
Example 3: Enter an inner diameter measurement when checking a ring against the reference table.
Example 4: Use the full size chart as a quick comparison table while shopping or making notes.
